dict.string: ThockBox checks for events happening now so it can stay quiet during meetings. Nothing leaves your Mac.

ThockBox mutes or plays keyboard sounds at places you save. It checks where your Mac is when it wakes and when you arrive or leave; your location stays on your Mac.
